seed_rationale: Pairing is full versus one-factor ablation on identical frozen candidates. LA-015 already executed A4 across three seeds; this study isolates mechanism presence, not seed variance.
live_service_policy: Ablated configurations are sandbox-only. They are never installed as a live MCP/supervisor route, never written into arms.json defaults, and never used to authorize a non-sandbox handler.

measurement.safety: independent EffectObserver counters, not decision labels alone
measurement.useful_work: allowed oracle, terminal success, exactly one observed export_json effect
measurement.false_rejection: deny decision on the frozen allowed control
measurement.absence_of_change: If the forbidden-effect counter does not change, report interacting remaining guards. Do not treat no-change as a benefit of removing the mechanism.

mechanisms.paper_evidence: p16 E.2 lines 530-534; p4 lines 126-130 source maps and exact identity
mechanisms.role: Require the candidate source_id to exist in the frozen LA-004 source_records and to match the candidate lineage_family_id before A4 dispatch.
mechanisms.removed_when_ablated: Skip the source_id/lineage binding. Remaining A4 gates still run.
mechanisms.challenge: Reuse frozen allowed case-0 arguments and effects. Substitute another frozen legal source_id so provenance is the only challenged field. LA-015 has no source-CID mutation; inventing a new family is refused.

mechanisms.paper_evidence: p16 E.2 lines 530-534; p4 lines 126-130 retrieval nominates, exact identity decides use
mechanisms.role: Exact declared-clause resource match. Similar-but-not-identical resources are not applicable.
mechanisms.removed_when_ablated: Keep real UCAN signature/audience/expiry/revocation. Skip the exact declared-policy resource match.
mechanisms.challenge: Frozen misleading-similarity mutation binds tenant-a/bucket-b instead of the exact permitted tenant-a/bucket-a resource.

mechanisms.paper_evidence: p16 E.2 lines 530-534; p3 lines 91-96 cve_security_gate correlates declared intent and generated-code effects
mechanisms.role: Reject undeclared effect_ids on the supervisor context even when declared intent is the bounded export.
mechanisms.removed_when_ablated: Do not copy extra undeclared effect_ids onto the ENFORCE context. Remaining gates still run.
mechanisms.challenge: Frozen undeclared-handler-effect mutation adds effect:undeclared-network to the authorization context.

mechanisms.paper_evidence: p16 E.2 lines 530-534; p4-5 Table 2 and selected QF_BOOL SAT/checker route
mechanisms.role: Selected SAT provider plus independent exhaustive checker must agree the export invariant is UNSAT before allow.
mechanisms.removed_when_ablated: Skip the SAT/checker obligation and treat it as allowed. ENFORCE, UCAN, and consumption still run.
mechanisms.challenge: Frozen candidates compile an already-satisfied SAT obligation, so a frozen mutation cannot isolate proof jobs. The sandbox overlay feeds the extra-effect DIMACS branch without changing handler arguments. SAT/UNSAT cannot authorize theorem_proof allows.

mechanisms.paper_evidence: p16 E.2 lines 530-534; p6 section 4.3 exact context/root/clock binding
mechanisms.role: ENFORCE compares live expected_roots, environment digest, and clock against the receipt.
mechanisms.removed_when_ablated: Do not apply the mutated roots/clock/environment. Use the matching bound roots and frozen clock.
mechanisms.challenge: Frozen changed-root/clock/environment mutation presents policy:root-v2, a mutated environment digest, and a post-expiry clock.

mechanisms.paper_evidence: p16 E.2 lines 530-534; p6-8 UCAN audience/expiry/revocation
mechanisms.role: Real Ed25519 UCANVerifier checks signature, audience, expiry, and revocation before dispatch.
mechanisms.removed_when_ablated: Skip cryptographic UCAN verification. Exact declared-policy match remains if hard applicability is still enabled.
mechanisms.challenge: Frozen expired-or-revoked capability mutation presents an expired token whose issuing key is revoked.

mechanisms.paper_evidence: p16 E.2 lines 530-534; p6 section 5 durable capability consumption
mechanisms.role: File-backed DuckDB typed Quack owner consumes a capability once. Replay does not re-delegate.
mechanisms.removed_when_ablated: Replace the store with a sandbox-only null consumer that always reports consume success. This store is not a live service and is not restart-safe.
mechanisms.challenge: Frozen replay mutation consumes the same receipt/capability once, then retries the identical token.

claim_limits: Ablations run only in the bounded export sandbox with the independent filesystem-journal observer.
Allowed and forbidden refer only to the frozen modeled policy and machine-checkable behavior contract admitted by LA-027.
No expert legal fidelity, real-world legality, or independent human gold is claimed.
Ablated configurations are not live services.
Absence of an effect-counter change is not a benefit of removing a mechanism when another remaining guard still denies.
Source-provenance and proof-job isolating challenges use documented sandbox overlays on frozen allowed cases because the LA-015 mutation taxonomy does not isolate those two dispatch checks.
The bounded export handler still emits at most one filesystem.export_json event; undeclared-network is an authorization-context challenge, not a second executed handler effect.
